source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Sanctifiers can instead form an [Attached Unit](vsdata:core-rule/forming-attached-units) with a model from your army that has Leader and either the **MINISTORUM PRIEST** or **INQUISITOR** keyword. That Leader receives [Scouts 6″](vsdata:core-ability/scouts) if it joins the Sanctifiers during Declare Battle Formations.

grants.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 2 of 24 sampled ability grants of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: qualifying model attaches to owner unit
